verdict.rationale: OpenCode offers no explicit region or residency selection. Users get indirect control over where their data goes: they can use local models (opencode-docs-53), run their own backend via `opencode serve` (opencode-docs-30, opencode-docs-10), or route all traffic through an internal enterprise AI gateway (opencode-docs-33). That control is undercut by a community report that telemetry is sent to OpenCode's servers with no way to disable it, even when using local models (opencode-comm-2). Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for any OpenCode-hosted data, documentation of where sessions and telemetry are stored, a telemetry opt-out, and independent corroboration of data-location controls.
